correctness.rationale: Face-balanced cross-polytope skeleton sampling has support s/d and signed Dirichlet(1,...,1), covariance 2/[d(s+1)] I. Exact affine kernel 1+d(s+1)x·y/2; Beta-tail integration gives 1+(s+1)/2(1-2/[d(s+1)])^s. Convexity and positive-measure opposite-sign kernel rows force only vertices to maximize. Log derivative of g(t)=t(1-2/[dt])^(t-1) gives strict rank increase; radial disintegration derives solid endpoint and stricter volume gap; Bernoulli remainder proves uniform 1/d bound and half-step law. Independent exact-fraction checks sampled all ranks for d<=23.
